title: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Sandwich-How to and Recipe | Byron Talbott

asr.full_text: Hi Water Fire control panel served from the back 435 Hey everyone, today is going to be a little bit different of a video I must admit its going to be an amazing grilled cheese That I've actually eaten with my wife the last 2 days for dinner So I hope you guys enjoy it and here we go so here I'm slicing my vine ripe red tomato it's actually really important to thinly and evenly slice the tomatoes so you can distribute it on the sandwich evenly it's really important to evenly distribute all the ingredients on the sandwich so they all melt and cook evenly. So I actually used three slices of swiss cheese, I cut one of them in half, and I use one on the bottom, one on the top, half of the bottom, half of the top, so it melts perfectly and evenly in the oven. So turn your flame on high heat I used 2 and a half tablespoons of unsalted butter. Heat it up just to about simmering and then throw both your sandwiches in there. So this is where it goes in the oven, it's about 400 degrees for about 10-15 minutes just check it, and here I'm just going to turn it over and it's going to be nice and beautifully golden brown. We're done. Alright so there you guys have it, beautiful grilled cheese with tomatoes. Just slightly toasted very crispy and crunchy and cheesy. Hopefully you guys enjoy this, and please subscribe and leave good comments below.
